messages:
maya (PM): quick 20m triage in 10m to decide bugs vs enhancements for post-launch backlog. join if free @igor @lina @eli @sam

igor (Eng): short question — are we using customer count or metric delta as primary signal?

maya (PM): both. tie-breaker rules in doc: >=2 customers -> bug; error/metric delta >=1% -> bug; single-customer feature -> enhancement.

lina (Support): flagging an embedding ordering regression from 3 customers in last 2 days. marking as BUG for the vote.

eli (Design): small onboarding header copy confusion. will drop a 1-line PR. enhancement unless it affects flow.

sam (SRE): i'll pull p95/p99 around rollout window. if p95 >250ms correlated -> escalate to P1.

igor (Eng): if it's a simple server fix or param revert i can patch within 24-48h. model retrain = enhancement unless correctness.

triage-bot: agenda & checklist added: https://docs.redwood.internal/triage/launch-backlog (private)

maya (PM): plan: run top 6 items, vote (thumbs up=bug), assign owner + due date, create GH issue. we'll offer paid expediting for customer-requested enhancements.

lina (Support): i'll paste customer snippets and impact notes before call.

eli (Design): copy PR ready — will link.

maya (PM): great. reminder in 8m. summary posted here after with decisions. :thumbsup:
